```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(reticulate)
library(rgee)
```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# USER INPUTS — edit these before running
# =============================================================================

LAT          <- 36.6058          # decimal degrees (e.g., US-ARM)
LON          <- -97.4888         # decimal degrees (e.g., US-ARM)
BUFFER_M     <- 100              # buffer radius in meters (applied to all sources)
DATE_START   <- as.Date("2022-01-01")
DATE_END     <- as.Date("2022-12-31")
OUTPUT_PATH  <- "."              # folder where the CSV will be saved
OUTPUT_FILE  <- "harmonized_dataset_test_US-ARM.csv"


# Paths to the three GPR model .txt files (download from Zenodo)
MODEL_PATH_S1   <- "~models/GPP_S1_model_R.txt"      # Aux + VV + VH
MODEL_PATH_S2   <- "~models/GPP_S2_model_R.txt"      # Aux + B2-B12
MODEL_PATH_S1S2 <- "~models/GPP_S1S2_model_R.txt"    # Aux + VV + VH + B2-B12


# Project name of Google Earth Engine
GEE_PROJECT <- "ee-yourproject"                       # change to your project

```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# GEE HARMONIZED RETRIEVAL PIPELINE
# Sources: DEM → SOIL → METEO → S1 (optional) → S2 (optional)
# Output:  one CSV with one row per date, static layers repeated per row
# =============================================================================


# =============================================================================
# GEE CONNECTION
# =============================================================================

# Use your virtualenv
use_virtualenv("~/.virtualenvs/r-reticulate", required = TRUE)

py_config()

# OPTIONAL but recommended:
# upgrade earthengine-api
py_install(
  "earthengine-api",
  pip = TRUE,
  pip_options = "--upgrade"
)

library(rgee)

# Remove old credentials
ee_clean_user_credentials()

# Authenticate using localhost mode
ee_Authenticate(auth_mode = "localhost")

# Initialize with your project
ee_Initialize(
  project = GEE_PROJECT 
)



# =============================================================================
# SETUP
# =============================================================================

# Full date sequence (one row per day)
dates <- seq(DATE_START, DATE_END, by = "day")

# Convenience: GEE point + buffer geometry (used by METEO, S1, S2)
pt_wgs84  <- ee$Geometry$Point(c(LON, LAT))
region    <- pt_wgs84$buffer(BUFFER_M)$bounds()

# =============================================================================
# 1. DEM  —  static, fetched once
# =============================================================================

get_dem <- function(lat, lon, buffer_m) {
  message(">>> Fetching DEM ...")
  pt     <- ee$Geometry$Point(c(lon, lat))
  buf    <- pt$buffer(buffer_m)$bounds()

  dem_image <- ee$ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/DEM/GLO30")$mosaic()$
    select("DEM")$rename("elevation")
  terrain   <- ee$Terrain$products(dem_image)

  vals <- terrain$reduceRegion(
    reducer   = ee$Reducer$mean(),
    geometry  = buf,
    scale     = 30,
    maxPixels = 1e8
  )$getInfo()

  tibble(
    Elevation_m = vals$elevation %||% NA_real_,
    Slope_deg   = vals$slope     %||% NA_real_,
    Aspect_deg  = vals$aspect    %||% NA_real_,
    Hillshade   = vals$hillshade %||% NA_real_
  )
}

dem_row <- tryCatch(
  get_dem(LAT, LON, BUFFER_M),
  error = function(e) {
    message("DEM failed: ", e$message)
    tibble(Elevation_m = NA_real_, Slope_deg = NA_real_,
           Aspect_deg  = NA_real_, Hillshade = NA_real_)
  }
)

# =============================================================================
# 2. SOIL  —  static, fetched once, averaged over 0-30 cm depth layers
# =============================================================================

get_soil <- function(lat, lon) {
  message(">>> Fetching SOIL ...")
  pt_wgs84 <- ee$Geometry$Point(c(lon, lat))

  layer_names <- c("bdod_mean", "cec_mean", "cfvo_mean", "clay_mean",
                   "nitrogen_mean", "ocd_mean", "ocs_mean", "phh2o_mean",
                   "sand_mean", "silt_mean", "soc_mean")

  layers <- set_names(
    map(layer_names, ~ ee$Image(paste0("projects/soilgrids-isric/", .x))),
    nm = sub("_mean$", "", layer_names)
  )

  proj    <- layers[[1]]$projection()
  pt_proj <- pt_wgs84$transform(proj, 1)

  extract_band_values <- function(image, prefix) {
    val <- image$reduceRegion(
      reducer   = ee$Reducer$first(),
      geometry  = pt_proj,
      scale     = 250,
      maxPixels = 1e9
    )$getInfo()
    if (is.null(val)) {
      band_names <- image$bandNames()$getInfo()
      val <- as.list(rep(NA_real_, length(band_names)))
      names(val) <- band_names
    }
    as_tibble(val) %>% set_names(paste0(prefix, "_", names(.)))
  }

  raw <- imap(layers, extract_band_values) %>% bind_cols()

  # Variables and depth suffixes present in SoilGrids band names
  variables <- c("bdod","cec","clay","sand","silt","nitrogen","phh2o","soc","ocd","ocs")
  depths    <- c("0-5cm","5-15cm","15-30cm","0-30cm")

  avg_var <- function(var) {
    cols <- intersect(
      paste0(var, "_", var, "_", depths, "_mean"),
      names(raw)
    )
    if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    mean(unlist(raw[cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # Scaling factors (divide raw integer values)
  sf <- c(bdod=100, cec=10, clay=10, sand=10, silt=10,
          nitrogen=100, phh2o=10, soc=10, ocd=10, ocs=10)

  soil_vals <- map_dbl(set_names(variables, variables), avg_var)

  tibble(
    bdod_mean     = soil_vals["bdod"]     / sf["bdod"],
    cec_mean      = soil_vals["cec"]      / sf["cec"],
    clay_mean     = soil_vals["clay"]     / sf["clay"],
    sand_mean     = soil_vals["sand"]     / sf["sand"],
    silt_mean     = soil_vals["silt"]     / sf["silt"],
    nitrogen_mean = soil_vals["nitrogen"] / sf["nitrogen"],
    phh2o_mean    = soil_vals["phh2o"]    / sf["phh2o"],
    soc_mean      = soil_vals["soc"]      / sf["soc"],
    ocd_mean      = soil_vals["ocd"]      / sf["ocd"],
    ocs_mean      = soil_vals["ocs"]      / sf["ocs"]
  )
}

soil_row <- tryCatch(
  get_soil(LAT, LON),
  error = function(e) {
    message("SOIL failed: ", e$message)
    tibble(bdod_mean=NA, cec_mean=NA, clay_mean=NA, sand_mean=NA, silt_mean=NA,
           nitrogen_mean=NA, phh2o_mean=NA, soc_mean=NA, ocd_mean=NA, ocs_mean=NA)
  }
)

# =============================================================================
# 3. METEO  —  daily ERA5-Land, one row per date
# =============================================================================

get_meteo_day <- function(lat, lon, date) {
  date_char <- format(date, "%Y-%m-%d")
  next_date <- format(date + 1, "%Y-%m-%d")
  pt        <- ee$Geometry$Point(c(lon, lat))

  img <- ee$ImageCollection("ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR")$
    filterDate(date_char, next_date)$first()

  pull <- function(band) {
    img$select(band)$reduceRegion(ee$Reducer$mean(), pt, 10000)$get(band)$getInfo()
  }

  raw <- list(
    t2m_min  = pull("temperature_2m_min"),
    t2m_max  = pull("temperature_2m_max"),
    t2m      = pull("temperature_2m"),
    dewp     = pull("dewpoint_temperature_2m"),
    precip   = pull("total_precipitation_sum"),
    srad     = pull("surface_net_solar_radiation_sum"),
    therm    = pull("surface_net_thermal_radiation_sum"),
    sensible = pull("surface_sensible_heat_flux_sum"),
    latent   = pull("surface_latent_heat_flux_sum"),
    stmin    = pull("soil_temperature_level_1_min"),
    stmax    = pull("soil_temperature_level_1_max"),
    swc      = pull("volumetric_soil_water_layer_1"),
    snowd    = pull("snow_depth"),
    snowf    = pull("snowfall_sum"),
    u10      = pull("u_component_of_wind_10m"),
    v10      = pull("v_component_of_wind_10m")
  )

  # Unit conversions
  TMEAN_C   <- (raw$t2m   %||% NA) - 273.15
  Dewp_C    <- (raw$dewp  %||% NA) - 273.15
  es        <- 0.6108 * exp((17.27 * TMEAN_C)  / (TMEAN_C  + 237.3))
  ea        <- 0.6108 * exp((17.27 * Dewp_C)   / (Dewp_C   + 237.3))

  tibble(
    date               = date,
    TMIN_C             = (raw$t2m_min  %||% NA) - 273.15,
    TMAX_C             = (raw$t2m_max  %||% NA) - 273.15,
    TMEAN_C            = TMEAN_C,
    Dewpoint_C         = Dewp_C,
    RAIN_mm            = (raw$precip   %||% NA) * 1000,
    SRAD_NET_MJm2      = (raw$srad     %||% NA) / 1e6,
    THERMAL_NET_MJm2   = (raw$therm    %||% NA) / 1e6,
    SENSIBLE_HEAT_MJm2 = (raw$sensible %||% NA) / 1e6,
    LATENT_HEAT_MJm2   = (raw$latent   %||% NA) / 1e6,
    SoilTemp_min_C     = (raw$stmin    %||% NA) - 273.15,
    SoilTemp_max_C     = (raw$stmax    %||% NA) - 273.15,
    SoilWater_m3m3     =  raw$swc      %||% NA,
    SnowDepth_cm       = (raw$snowd    %||% NA) * 100,
    Snowfall_mm        = (raw$snowf    %||% NA) * 1000,
    Wind_m_s           = sqrt(((raw$u10 %||% NA)^2) + ((raw$v10 %||% NA)^2)),
    VPD_kPa            = pmax(es - ea, 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

message(">>> Fetching METEO (", length(dates), " days) ...")
meteo_df <- map_dfr(dates, function(d) {
  tryCatch(
    get_meteo_day(LAT, LON, d),
    error = function(e) {
      message("METEO failed for ", d, ": ", e$message)
      tibble(date = d,
             TMIN_C=NA, TMAX_C=NA, TMEAN_C=NA, Dewpoint_C=NA,
             RAIN_mm=NA, SRAD_NET_MJm2=NA, THERMAL_NET_MJm2=NA,
             SENSIBLE_HEAT_MJm2=NA, LATENT_HEAT_MJm2=NA,
             SoilTemp_min_C=NA, SoilTemp_max_C=NA, SoilWater_m3m3=NA,
             SnowDepth_cm=NA, Snowfall_mm=NA, Wind_m_s=NA, VPD_kPa=NA)
    }
  )
})

# =============================================================================
# 4. S1 (optional)  —  daily, VV + VH only
# =============================================================================

get_s1_day <- function(lat, lon, date, buf_geom) {
  date_str  <- format(date, "%Y-%m-%d")
  next_date <- format(date + 1, "%Y-%m-%d")

  s1 <- ee$ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S1_GRD")$
    filterBounds(buf_geom)$
    filterDate(date_str, next_date)

  if (s1$size()$getInfo() == 0) return(tibble(date = date, VV = NA_real_, VH = NA_real_))

  img <- s1$first()
  has_band <- function(b) img$bandNames()$contains(b)$getInfo()
  pull_band <- function(b) {
    if (!has_band(b)) return(NA_real_)
    img$select(b)$reduceRegion(ee$Reducer$mean(), buf_geom, 10, maxPixels=1e8)$getInfo()[[b]]
  }

  tibble(date = date, VV = pull_band("VV"), VH = pull_band("VH"))
}

message(">>> Fetching S1 ...")
s1_df <- map_dfr(dates, function(d) {
  tryCatch(
    get_s1_day(LAT, LON, d, region),
    error = function(e) {
      message("S1 failed for ", d, ": ", e$message)
      tibble(date = d, VV = NA_real_, VH = NA_real_)
    }
  )
})

# Check if S1 has ANY valid observation over the full period
s1_available <- any(!is.na(s1_df$VV) | !is.na(s1_df$VH))

# =============================================================================
# 5. S2 (optional)  —  daily, all bands + cloud probability
# =============================================================================

get_s2_day <- function(lat, lon, date, buf_geom) {
  date_str  <- format(date, "%Y-%m-%d")
  next_date <- format(date + 1, "%Y-%m-%d")

  s2_sr <- ee$ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED")$
    filterBounds(buf_geom)$filterDate(date_str, next_date)
  s2_cp <- ee$ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY")$
    filterBounds(buf_geom)$filterDate(date_str, next_date)

  joined <- ee$Join$inner()$apply(
    s2_sr, s2_cp,
    ee$Filter$equals(leftField = "system:index", rightField = "system:index")
  )

  na_row <- tibble(date = date,
                   B2=NA, B3=NA, B4=NA, B5=NA, B6=NA, B7=NA,
                   B8=NA, B8A=NA, B11=NA, B12=NA, cloud_probability=NA)

  if (joined$size()$getInfo() == 0) return(na_row)

  first_pair  <- joined$first()
  img_sr      <- ee$Image(first_pair$get("primary"))
  img_cp      <- ee$Image(first_pair$get("secondary"))
  bands       <- c("B2","B3","B4","B5","B6","B7","B8","B8A","B11","B12")

  refl <- img_sr$select(bands)$reduceRegion(
    reducer = ee$Reducer$mean(), geometry = buf_geom, scale = 10, maxPixels = 1e8
  )$getInfo()

  cloud <- img_cp$select("probability")$reduceRegion(
    reducer = ee$Reducer$mean(), geometry = buf_geom, scale = 10, maxPixels = 1e8
  )$get("probability")$getInfo()

  tibble(
    date             = date,
    B2               = refl$B2   %||% NA, B3  = refl$B3  %||% NA,
    B4               = refl$B4   %||% NA, B5  = refl$B5  %||% NA,
    B6               = refl$B6   %||% NA, B7  = refl$B7  %||% NA,
    B8               = refl$B8   %||% NA, B8A = refl$B8A %||% NA,
    B11              = refl$B11  %||% NA, B12 = refl$B12 %||% NA,
    cloud_probability = cloud    %||% NA
  )
}

message(">>> Fetching S2 ...")
s2_df <- map_dfr(dates, function(d) {
  tryCatch(
    get_s2_day(LAT, LON, d, region),
    error = function(e) {
      message("S2 failed for ", d, ": ", e$message)
      tibble(date = d,
             B2=NA, B3=NA, B4=NA, B5=NA, B6=NA, B7=NA,
             B8=NA, B8A=NA, B11=NA, B12=NA, cloud_probability=NA)
    }
  )
})

s2_available <- any(!is.na(s2_df$B2))

# =============================================================================
# 6. MERGE  —  DEM + SOIL (static) broadcast over all dates,
#              then left-join METEO, then conditionally S1, S2
# =============================================================================

message(">>> Merging all sources ...")

# Static backbone: one row per date with DEM + SOIL repeated
static_df <- tibble(
  date = dates,
  lat  = LAT,
  lon  = LON
) %>%
  bind_cols(dem_row[rep(1, length(dates)), ]) %>%
  bind_cols(soil_row[rep(1, length(dates)), ])

# Join METEO (always present)
merged <- static_df %>%
  left_join(meteo_df, by = "date")

# Conditionally join S1
if (s1_available) {
  message(">>> S1 data found — adding VV, VH columns.")
  merged <- merged %>% left_join(s1_df, by = "date")
} else {
  message(">>> No S1 data available for this period/location — columns omitted.")
}

# Conditionally join S2
if (s2_available) {
   message(">>> S2 data found — adding band + cloud_probability columns.")
  merged <- merged %>% left_join(s2_df, by = "date")
} else {
  message(">>> No S2 data available for this period/location — columns omitted.")
}

# =============================================================================
# 7. EXPORT
# =============================================================================

out_file <- file.path(OUTPUT_PATH, OUTPUT_FILE)
write.csv(merged, file = out_file, row.names = FALSE)
message(">>> Done! CSV saved to: ", out_file)
message("    Rows : ", nrow(merged))
message("    Cols : ", ncol(merged))
message("    S1   : ", if (s1_available) "included" else "omitted")
message("    S2   : ", if (s2_available) "included" else "omitted")
```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# LOAD MODELS (this might take a while)
# =============================================================================

load_model <- function(model_path, model_name) {
  # Source into a fresh temporary environment to avoid GlobalEnv collisions
  # and the "negative length vectors" error that occurs when large matrix
  # assignments are parsed directly into .GlobalEnv via source()
  tmp_env   <- new.env(parent = baseenv())
  sys.source(model_path, envir = tmp_env, keep.source = FALSE)
  model_obj <- as.list(tmp_env)
  assign(model_name, model_obj, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  message("Loaded model: ", model_name, " (", length(model_obj), " components)")
}
 
load_model(MODEL_PATH_S1,   "GPPmodel_s1")
load_model(MODEL_PATH_S2,   "GPPmodel_s2")
load_model(MODEL_PATH_S1S2, "GPPmodel_s1s2")
 
```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# GPR APPLICATION PIPELINE
# Applies one of three pre-trained GPR models per row depending on data
# availability: S1-only | S2-only | S1+S2
# Input:  harmonized_dataset.csv  (output of gee_retrieval_pipeline.R)
# Output: gpp_predictions.csv

# =============================================================================
# USER INPUTS
# =============================================================================

INPUT_CSV   <- "harmonized_dataset_test_US-ARM.csv"   # path to retrieval pipeline output
OUTPUT_CSV  <- "gpp_predictions_US-ARM.csv"
TARGET_VAR  <- "GPP"                      # used for output column naming
CLOUD_THRESH <- 30


# =============================================================================
# FEATURE ORDER  (must match training exactly)
# =============================================================================

# Aux block: SOIL → DEM → METEO (28 features)
AUX_COLS <- c(
  # SOIL
  "bdod_mean", "cec_mean", "clay_mean", "sand_mean", "silt_mean",
  "nitrogen_mean", "phh2o_mean", "soc_mean", "ocd_mean", "ocs_mean",
  # DEM
  "Elevation_m", "Slope_deg", "Aspect_deg", "Hillshade",
  # METEO
  "TMIN_C", "TMAX_C", "TMEAN_C", "Dewpoint_C", "RAIN_mm",
  "SRAD_NET_MJm2", "THERMAL_NET_MJm2", "SENSIBLE_HEAT_MJm2",
  "LATENT_HEAT_MJm2", "SoilTemp_min_C", "SoilTemp_max_C",
  "SoilWater_m3m3", "Wind_m_s", "VPD_kPa"
)

S1_COLS   <- c("VV", "VH")
S2_COLS   <- c("B2", "B3", "B4", "B5", "B6", "B7", "B8", "B8A", "B11", "B12")

# Full feature vectors per model (order matters for GPR algebra)
FEATURES_S1   <- c(AUX_COLS, S1_COLS)                     # 30 features
FEATURES_S2   <- c(AUX_COLS, S2_COLS)                     # 38 features
FEATURES_S1S2 <- c(AUX_COLS, S1_COLS, S2_COLS)            # 40 features

# =============================================================================
# SETUP
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)

df <- read.csv(INPUT_CSV, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df$date <- as.Date(df$date)

# Detect which optional column blocks are present in the CSV
has_s1_cols <- all(S1_COLS %in% names(df))
has_s2_cols <- all(S2_COLS %in% names(df))

message("S1 columns present in CSV : ", has_s1_cols)
message("S2 columns present in CSV : ", has_s2_cols)

# =============================================================================
# HELPER: check if a row has valid (non-NA) values for a set of columns
# =============================================================================

row_has <- function(row, cols) {
  if (!all(cols %in% names(row))) return(FALSE)
  all(!is.na(row[cols]))
}

# =============================================================================
# GPR PREDICT  — generalised version of your original function
#
# Expects model to contain components named with a shared suffix, e.g.:
#   hyp_ell_<suffix>, mx_<suffix>, sx_<suffix>, X_train_<suffix>,
#   mean_model_<suffix>, hyp_sig_<suffix>, XDX_pre_calc_<suffix>,
#   alpha_coefficients_<suffix>, Linv_pre_calc_<suffix>
#
# The suffix is detected automatically from the model object names.
# =============================================================================

gpr_predict <- function(feature_vector, model) {

  # --- detect suffix from model object keys ---------------------------------
  keys   <- names(model)
  suffix <- sub("^hyp_ell_", "", keys[grepl("^hyp_ell_", keys)][1])

  # --- pull model components ------------------------------------------------
  hyp_ell    <- model[[paste0("hyp_ell_",           suffix)]]
  mx         <- model[[paste0("mx_",                suffix)]]
  sx         <- model[[paste0("sx_",                suffix)]]
  X_train    <- model[[paste0("X_train_",           suffix)]]
  mean_model <- model[[paste0("mean_model_",        suffix)]]
  hyp_sig    <- model[[paste0("hyp_sig_",           suffix)]]
  XDX        <- model[[paste0("XDX_pre_calc_",      suffix)]]
  alpha      <- as.vector(model[[paste0("alpha_coefficients_", suffix)]])
  Linv       <- model[[paste0("Linv_pre_calc_",     suffix)]]

  n_feat <- length(feature_vector)

  if (length(hyp_ell) != n_feat)
    stop(sprintf("Feature length mismatch: got %d, model expects %d",
                 n_feat, length(hyp_ell)))

  # --- GPR algebra (matches your original implementation) -------------------
  x_arr           <- array(feature_vector, dim = c(n_feat, 1, 1))
  mx_arr          <- array(mx,             dim = c(n_feat, 1, 1))
  sx_arr          <- array(sx,             dim = c(n_feat, 1, 1))
  hyp_ell_arr     <- array(hyp_ell,        dim = c(n_feat, 1, 1))

  x_norm          <- (x_arr - mx_arr) / sx_arr
  x_norm_ell      <- x_norm * hyp_ell_arr

  PtTPt           <- as.vector(colSums(x_norm_ell * x_norm) * (-0.5))
  PtTDX           <- as.vector(X_train %*% array(x_norm_ell, dim = c(n_feat, 1)))

  arg1            <- exp(PtTPt) * hyp_sig
  k_star          <- exp(PtTDX - (XDX * 0.5))

  mean_pred       <- sum(k_star * alpha) * arg1 + mean_model
  mean_pred       <- max(mean_pred, 0)

  k_star_unc      <- k_star * arg1
  Vvec            <- Linv %*% k_star_unc
  variance        <- sqrt(abs(hyp_sig - sum(Vvec^2)))

  list(mean_pred = mean_pred, variance = variance)
}

# =============================================================================
# MAIN LOOP
# =============================================================================



results <- vector("list", nrow(df))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

  row <- df[i, , drop = FALSE]

  # Determine which model to use based on data availability for this row
  s1_ok  <- has_s1_cols && row_has(row, S1_COLS)
  s2_ok  <- has_s2_cols && row_has(row, S2_COLS)
  aux_ok <- row_has(row, AUX_COLS)

  model_used <- NA_character_
  pred       <- NA_real_
  unc        <- NA_real_

  if (!aux_ok) {
    message(sprintf("Row %d (%s): Aux features incomplete — skipping.", i, row$date))

  } else if (s1_ok && s2_ok) {
    # --- S1 + S2 model ------------------------------------------------------
    tryCatch({
      fv         <- as.numeric(row[FEATURES_S1S2])
      out        <- gpr_predict(fv, GPPmodel_s1s2)
      pred       <- out$mean_pred
      unc        <- out$variance
      model_used <- "S1+S2"
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("Row %d (%s) S1+S2 model failed: %s", i, row$date, e$message))
    })

  } else if (s2_ok) {
    # --- S2-only model ---
    if (!is.na(row$cloud_probability) && row$cloud_probability > CLOUD_THRESH) {
        message(sprintf("Row %d (%s): S2 too cloudy — skipping S2 model.", i, row$date))
    } else {
        tryCatch({
            fv         <- as.numeric(row[FEATURES_S2])
            out        <- gpr_predict(fv, GPPmodel_s2)
            pred       <- out$mean_pred
            unc        <- out$variance
            model_used <- "S2"
        }, error = function(e) {
            message(sprintf("Row %d (%s) S2 model failed: %s", i, row$date, e$message))
        })
    }

  } else if (s1_ok) {
    # --- S1-only model ------------------------------------------------------
    tryCatch({
      fv         <- as.numeric(row[FEATURES_S1])
      out        <- gpr_predict(fv, GPPmodel_s1)
      pred       <- out$mean_pred
      unc        <- out$variance
      model_used <- "S1"
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("Row %d (%s) S1 model failed: %s", i, row$date, e$message))
    })

  } else {
    message(sprintf("Row %d (%s): No S1 or S2 data — skipping.", i, row$date))
  }

  results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    date                          = row$date,
    lat                           = row$lat,
    lon                           = row$lon,
    model_used                    = model_used,
    stringsAsFactors              = FALSE
  )
  results[[i]][[paste0(TARGET_VAR, "_pred")]] <- pred
  results[[i]][[paste0(TARGET_VAR, "_unc")]]  <- unc
}

# =============================================================================
# COMBINE & SAVE
# =============================================================================

results_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(results)

# Summary
total     <- nrow(results_df)
n_s1s2    <- sum(results_df$model_used == "S1+S2", na.rm = TRUE)
n_s2      <- sum(results_df$model_used == "S2",    na.rm = TRUE)
n_s1      <- sum(results_df$model_used == "S1",    na.rm = TRUE)
n_skipped <- sum(is.na(results_df$model_used))

message("\n========== PREDICTION SUMMARY ==========")
message(sprintf("  Total rows   : %d", total))
message(sprintf("  S1+S2 model  : %d rows", n_s1s2))
message(sprintf("  S2 model     : %d rows", n_s2))
message(sprintf("  S1 model     : %d rows", n_s1))
message(sprintf("  Skipped (NA) : %d rows", n_skipped))
message("=========================================\n")

write.csv(results_df, file = OUTPUT_CSV, row.names = FALSE)
message("Predictions saved to: ", OUTPUT_CSV)

```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# VISUALISATION
# =============================================================================
 
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare plot data — only rows with a valid prediction
plot_df <- results_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[paste0(TARGET_VAR, "_pred")]])) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    date       = as.Date(date),
    pred       = .data[[paste0(TARGET_VAR, "_pred")]],
    unc        = .data[[paste0(TARGET_VAR, "_unc")]],
    ymin       = pred - unc,
    ymax       = pred + unc,
    model_used = factor(model_used, levels = c("S1", "S2", "S1+S2"))
  )
 
# Colour palette per model type
model_colours <- c(
  "S1"    = "blue",   # orange
  "S2"    = "red",   # blue
  "S1+S2" = "purple"    # green
)
 
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = date)) +
 
  # Uncertainty errorbars
  geom_errorbar(
  aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, colour = model_used),
  width = 0.2,        # controls horizontal cap width
  linewidth = 0.4,
  alpha = 0.7
) +
 
  # Prediction line connecting all points
  geom_line(
    aes(y = pred),
    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
 
  # Coloured points per model type
  geom_point(
    aes(y = pred, colour = model_used, shape = model_used),
    size = 2.8, stroke = 0.3
  ) +
 
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colours, name = "Model") +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = model_colours, name = "Model") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("S1" = 17, "S2" = 16, "S1+S2" = 15),
    name   = "Model"
  ) +
 
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
 
  labs(
    #title    = paste(TARGET_VAR, "predictions from GPR"),
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "S1: %d days  |  S2: %d days  |  S1+S2: %d days",
      n_s1, n_s2, n_s1s2, n_skipped
    ),
    x       = "Date",
    y       = paste0(TARGET_VAR, " (predicted)"),
    #caption = "Ribbon = pred \u00b1 uncertainty"
  ) +
 
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40"),
        legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
 
print(p)

```
